phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F8 Phase C — Exact Aggregate-Control Rank Audit
purpose: Quantify exactly how much of the 35-cell in-boundary F8 matrix is identified by published W0/W1 total-F8 controls after direct and component-bilateral source coverage both failed, and reproduce that historical identification result deterministically from retained evidence.

reproduction_boundary.rule: A fresh ECB QSA query may reveal publication or availability changes, but it must not silently rewrite or invalidate the historical Phase C rank result. Reopening F8 requires explicit new evidence and a new assessment.

canonical_variables: 35 in-boundary holder→issuer F8 cells over H/C/F/G/X/BNR; X→X is outside the Romanian national-accounts boundary
equation_families: 1 W1 total asset equation for resident holders→X
1 W1 total liability equation for X→resident issuers
known_accounting_dependency: sum(resident W0 holder assets) - W1 assets equals sum(resident W0 issuer liabilities) - W1 liabilities, subject to published precision

stock_BNR_zero_scenario.premise: Published non-consolidated BNR W0 F8 liability stock is zero. Under the non-negative stock-position partition premise, holder→BNR stock cells are tested as zero constraints.
stock_BNR_zero_scenario.prohibited_extension: Zero aggregate F8 transactions do not imply bilateral zero flows because transaction signs can offset.

disposition_rule: If no useful unconditional bilateral core is rank-unique, freeze F8 at the aggregate-only public-data boundary and advance accounting recovery rather than inventing a matrix.
system_dynamics_conformity: Accounting-only recovery; no feedback, delay, behavioural equation or closure status changes.
